messages:
riley.ops: RCA published: https://internal.redwood/rca/3112345678. Short summary: a recent policy change to the global rate-limiter reduced the token-bucket refill for dedupe-proxy by 30% in prod, which slowly increased request queuing and caused elevated timeouts for ~22 minutes. We reverted the policy and restored normal refill. Action table in the doc 1; owners please ack today.

ratebot: Timeline (auto): 08:50 policy deploy -> 09:05 queue growth detected -> 09:12 timeout spike -> 09:20 partial rollback -> 09:28 full rollback -> 09:32 service stable. Attachments: rate metrics + bucket traces.

anya.eng: I'll take Action 1: "add policy canary and simulation". Plan: simulate token-bucket behavior with representative traffic shapes in staging and add a deploy-time canary gate that checks queue latency. ETA: Wed 2024-07-10. Will post PR.

mohit.sre: I'll own Action 2: "add sliding-window alert for queue latency". Steps: add a 5m p95 queue-latency alert and a dashboard widget for the dedupe lane. Proposed checkpoint: Mon 2024-07-08 10:00 PT. Can everyone confirm?

kevin.prod: Need a short CSM note for affected customers: I'll draft a non-technical blurb and share here for review. Wants to avoid jargon but include what we fixed and what we're doing to prevent recurrence.

lucy.cs: FYI I saw ~10 support tickets; most were timeouts. I'll include the RCA link in replies and offer an optional follow-up to heavily impacted accounts.

riley.ops: Office hours to walk through the RCA and action items: Thu 2024-07-04 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent to #all-hands). Please post questions here beforehand.

anya.eng: \u2705 taking the canary item. Will add unit + integration tests and a traffic sim job.

mohit.sre: \u2705 checkpoint ok for Mon 7/8 10:00 PT.

kevin.prod: Draft posted: "We experienced a short service degradation for request deduplication due to a rate-limiter policy change. The issue is resolved and engineers have added staging validation and monitoring to prevent recurrence. No customer data was exposed. Contact your CSM for any follow-up." Feedback?

lucy.cs: Draft looks good. Suggest adding "we've scheduled an extra watch for one week" line.

kevin.prod: Added watch note and updated draft.

riley.ops: Two asks: 1) owners, react with :white_check_mark: to accept; 2) paste PR links and monitoring screenshots back into this thread for verification. We'll close items after the one-week watch unless new regressions appear. If urgent, escalate in #eng-oncall.

anya.eng: \u2705 Will link PR when ready.

mohit.sre: \u2705 I'll add alert rule and upload graph snapshots at checkpoint.

kevin.prod: \u2705 will send customer blurb after office hours review.

lucy.cs: \u2705 will include RCA link in support replies and follow-up with any escalations.

riley.ops: Thanks team. We'll reconvene at the checkpoint and publish the customer note after review. Post any evidence here so I can close items.
